title: Dialog over a backdrop
summary: position: absolute with inset: 0 covers the parent; grid centers the dialog on top.
explanation: inset: 0 is shorthand for top, right, bottom and left set to 0. An absolutely positioned child with those four offsets stretches to cover its positioned parent exactly.
The backdrop is a grid, so place-items: center puts the dialog in the middle. Later siblings paint over earlier ones, which is why the backdrop is written after the page content.
tryThis: Remove position: relative from .stage: the backdrop now covers the whole page instead.
Change the backdrop to place-items: start and see the dialog move to the corner.

children.text: Page content sits underneath. The backdrop covers all of it.
